name: wisdom-distill
description: Squeeze three to five durable lessons out of the owner's own words from the last seven days into a weekly note in the insights folder. The LLM reads only a collector's digest, never the raw corpus. Triggers: "/wisdom-distill", "distill my week", "weekly wisdom".
